title: [main] Closing the BC browser tab during quote-to-order reservation leaves a partial sales order and the source quote
summary: Converting a sales quote to an order now holds off reservation until all quote lines have been copied. Closing the browser tab mid-conversion can no longer commit a partial sales order and leave the source quote behind.
key_points: Reservation during quote-to-order conversion is deferred until the conversion completes
Prevents a committed partial order when the session is interrupted
Change applied to codeunit 86 in the W1, CH, IT and RU layers
Tests added in ERM Sales Quotes
quote: Defer manual reservation until conversion completes, so interruption cannot preserve a partially converted order.
